touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Barrow upon Humber qualifies as a local detour through THE PRIORY and CHURCH OF HOLY TRINITY. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Barrow upon Humber: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Barrow upon Humber offers THE PRIORY, CHURCH OF HOLY TRINITY, Village Cross within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: THE PRIORY
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with THE PRIORY and CHURCH OF HOLY TRINITY, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
